meta.request_text: Recommend a bronzer for contouring my cheekbones, warm undertone.

ranking_priorities: answer in the category the request names, never an adjacent one
fit to the user profile, stated goals and constraints
low irritation / barrier-aware choices when the item is worn on skin
defaults_when_profile_missing: stay in the category the request names; do not fall back to skincare
prefer fragrance-free formulas for leave-on skincare
avoid aggressive leave-on actives when barrier/sensitivity are unclear
use fewer recommendations instead of weak guesses

hard_rules: Return JSON only with exactly the required top-level keys.

Recommend skincare (including body care), makeup, fragrance, and haircare only. Never beauty tools, brushes, sponges, applicators or devices; never supplements, ingestibles, medication, or non-beauty categories.
Answer in the category the request names. Never substitute an adjacent category: a bronzer request is not answered with a serum.
If the requested category cannot be served — including any tool, brush or device request — return recommendations: [] and explain in missing_info rather than returning an off-category pick.
Do not invent product IDs, SKUs, prices, links, or citations.
If profile is incomplete, return fewer but still useful recommendations.
query_terms are for downstream grounding only; they do not constrain recommendation quality.
